name: copy_longs_then_call_handler
description: If the pointer passed on the stack is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a table inside the structure held in an address register into that buffer. It then calls a routine through the code pointer register; the caller is find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: fill_table_sized_by_max
description: Walks a linked list to find the largest value in a chosen field, then writes a header and a table of incrementing longword markers sized by that maximum. It makes several calls through the code pointer register and returns a failure value when one of them yields zero.

name: copy_longs_then_call_handler
description: If the pointer passed on the stack is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a table inside the structure held in an address register into that buffer. It then calls a routine through the code pointer register; the caller is find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: trap_then_start_payload
description: Sets a few globals, performs a system trap, and stores a four-byte signature in a global. It calls one routine, writes a short machine-code stub at a fixed memory location, and jumps there to start the loaded code.

name: install_payload_and_jump
description: Sets a global and stores a four-byte signature, calls one routine, writes a short machine-code stub at a fixed memory location and jumps there. It also refers to the text CHFI and touches the interrupt request register.

name: unpack_compressed_block
description: When the first longword matches the four-byte signature, it reads header fields and then decodes a bit-driven stream. Literal bytes are copied and earlier output bytes are copied backwards by distance until the output start is reached.

name: install_vectors_and_clear_ram
description: Copies a table of 256 longwords into low memory and clears memory from the low area up to the top of the first half megabyte, calling a routine to get a result. If that result is zero, it copies a block into low memory and jumps to it; otherwise it halts in a loop.

name: clear_ram_then_run_block
description: Clears low memory up to the top of the first half megabyte, then calls a routine that returns a length and a status. When the status is zero it copies that many bytes into low memory and jumps to the copied code, otherwise it loops forever.

name: initialize_hardware_and_copy_block
description: Writes constants to a global and to a CIA-B register, saves two address values into globals and calls several routines. It then copies 128 longwords from one block to the block 128 longwords further on, and finishes by calling one more routine.

name: set_clear_byte_flags
description: Computes a byte address from an address register plus a fixed offset, sets bits 6, 5, 4 and 3, then clears bits 7 and 3, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: set_byte_bits_with_pulse
description: Sets bit 7 and bit 3 of a byte addressed from an address register plus a fixed offset, briefly clearing bit 3 in between. The other bits are unchanged.

name: lookup_name_in_hash_table
description: Measures a zero-terminated name and computes a hash from its characters, reducing it to one of 72 buckets. It walks that bucket's chain comparing the upper-case name with stored entries, and on a match it copies the stored data before returning.

name: copy_matched_entry_records
description: Compares the upper-case name with stored entries in a chain, and when one matches it copies that entry's record data to the destination buffer in longword and byte chunks. A helper is called between chunks, and the copy repeats for each remaining record.

name: divide_index_and_compare
description: Divides a value by eleven and compares the quotient's low word with a stored word in a structure. When they differ it passes the packed remainder and quotient to a helper and then calls another helper, and it always calls a final helper.

name: step_position_toward_target
description: Sets bit 2 of a control byte, then steps a position one unit at a time toward a target value, choosing the direction from the comparison and pulsing bit 0 on each step. It stores the final position in a structure and, if the position changed, programs a pair of hardware registers, waits for a status bit and clears a bit in another register.

name: program_bytes_and_wait_ready
description: Writes four constant bytes into registers addressed from an address register, spins until bit 1 of one register is set, then clears bit 0 of another register.

name: clear_flags_and_wait
description: Writes constant values to several byte locations referenced through a base pointer, spins until a flag bit in one of those locations is set, and clears a bit in another location before returning.

name: toggle_bit_while_status_set
description: Sets bit 1 of a control byte, then repeatedly pulses bit 0 and calls a helper while a status bit in a global stays set. It then calls a final helper and clears a word field in a structure.

name: configure_disk_sync_transfer
description: Sets DMA and disk control registers, writes the standard disk sync word and a data pointer taken from a structure, and starts the transfer. It waits on a global flag bit and a drive status bit, then writes the transfer length and stops.

name: decode_mfm_sector_checksum
description: Scans a track buffer for disk sync words, then decodes an MFM-encoded sector by merging interleaved odd and even bits and XOR-ing the words into a running checksum. It returns when the checksum matches the stored value, and otherwise retries up to four times before calling an error routine.

name: or_byte_with_constant
description: Returns its byte argument with a fixed mask of bits forced on, using a bitwise OR, so the result comes back in the return register.

name: decode_bit_stream_entry
description: Copies a block into a working buffer, then runs a bit-driven decoding loop that refills its shift value through a helper whenever it runs out. It also writes a palette entry through a colour register.

name: refill_bit_buffer_from_input
description: Reads a longword just before the input pointer, stores its low byte into the output word together with the high byte of the data register, and returns the value shifted right by one with the top bit set.

name: shift_bits_with_refill
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a count held in a data register, calling a helper to refill the buffer whenever it becomes zero. The helper's result also updates the count.

name: install_trap_handler
description: Stores a handler routine address in a global, issues a system trap, and returns zero.

name: poll_fire_button_then_count
description: Repeatedly waits for an interrupt-set flag byte and reads the fire-button status bit from a global, calling helpers on each pass. After the loop it counts 250 flag ticks, resets a counter to four, calls helpers again and returns.

name: toggle_parity_and_store_word
description: Flips a parity byte, and on every second flip advances a counter by two and writes a stored word into four positions spaced eight words apart in a block addressed from another register.

name: toggle_parity_and_decrement_store
description: Flips a second parity byte, and on every second flip decrements a counter by two, writing a stored word into four positions spaced eight words apart only while the counter stays non-negative.

name: expand_nibble_table_entries
description: Calls a helper 32 times, then expands each of 32 table words into a destination structure, storing each four-bit nibble along with its negated value.

name: find_largest_nibble_in_word
description: Scans the four four-bit fields of a word and keeps the largest value in the result register, which the caller then uses.

name: advance_nibble_counters_on_tick
description: Counts down a tick counter and, every fourth tick, walks 32 pairs of entries. For each entry it either increments a word when a nibble differs from a stored value, or decrements the stored count when that count is non-zero.

name: decrement_nibble_fields_on_tick
description: Counts down a tick counter and, every fourth tick, decrements each non-zero four-bit field in 32 stored words by one.

name: initialize_audio_channels_and_timers
description: Saves several custom chip and CIA register values into globals, disables and re-enables DMA and interrupts, and programs timers. It waits for a raster position and then writes four audio channel register blocks using values from globals.

name: build_copper_list_pointers
description: Fills a memory table with register-address and value pairs: four blocks of incrementing address words with a fixed stride, then 80 entries that address a sequence of registers with zero values. It stores the table end in a global pointer and counter.

name: restore_saved_dma_and_interrupts
description: Disables all DMA channels and interrupts, then restores the DMA and interrupt enable values saved earlier. It also stores a pointer taken from a sub-structure in a global and stores the incoming data register value.

name: write_interrupt_request_values
description: Stores 255 in one global and 32 in another. The listed facts tie the interrupt request register to this routine, so the writes probably acknowledge interrupt requests.

name: write_interrupt_request_mask
description: Writes 255 to one global and 8192 to another. The listed facts tie these registers to the CIA-B interrupt control and the interrupt request register, and the routine returns the incoming data register value unchanged.

name: parse_audio_event_into_channel
description: Reads a four-byte event from a stream and splits out an instrument index, a period and an effect code. name: compare_period_with_target
description: Copies the low twelve bits of a word from the event record into a field and clears a flag. If the value equals a stored target it zeroes the field, and if it is lower than the target it sets the flag.

name: process_audio_effect_command
description: Applies one audio effect to a channel record, choosing the action from the low nibble of the command byte. name: select_marker_and_halt

name: depack_lz_bitstream_loop
description: Depacks an LZ-style bitstream by repeatedly reading a flag bit. A set flag copies a run of earlier output bytes at a short distance, and a clear flag reads a literal count and copies literal bytes backwards, refilling the bit buffer through helpers.

name: continue_depack_literal_loop
description: Is a mid-stream entry into the same depacker. It reads a literal count, copies literal bytes backwards from the bit reader, and returns when the output reaches its start, or runs a short delay loop first if a flag is set.

name: copy_backref_run_in_depack

name: copy_backref_run_then_continue
description: Is another entry into the same depacker. It copies a run of earlier output bytes at a stored distance, then reads further flag bits and literal counts until the output is complete.

name: fetch_shifted_bit_buffer

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count

name: fill_block_with_pattern

name: decode_joystick_direction_bits

description: Writes four pairs of fixed words into a memory table. Each pair holds a value that steps by 8000 from zero and a count of seven.

name: store_four_stepped_pairs
description: Writes four pairs of fixed words into a memory table, where each pair holds a value that steps by 8000 from a starting value and a count of seven.

name: copy_anim_form_data
description: Checks that a block starts with the FORM and ANIM tags, then copies a computed number of longwords from the source to the destination. If the tags do not match it sets the background colour and loops on a status bit.

name: decode_anim_delta_frame
description: Walks the chunks of an animation form, looking for the delta-compressed frame data. It decodes run and copy commands that write bytes into the frame buffer using a row stride, stopping at the end of the frame.

name: unpack_ilbm_body_rows
description: Finds the header and the body chunk of an ILBM form, takes the size values from the header, and writes the body rows out as bytes. It loops over the rows, decrementing the row count until the body is complete, and sets the background colour while it runs.

name: unpack_packbits_row
description: Decodes one run-length packed row: a negative count byte repeats the following byte, and a non-negative count copies that many plus one literal bytes, writing to the output until the row length is reached.

name: wait_for_status_byte_value
description: Busy-waits until the high byte of a status global equals a fixed value, then enters an endless loop.

name: run_counted_steps_until_status
description: Repeatedly sets two table words, calls helpers and waits on the raster, checking the returned status each pass. It stops early when a status is non-zero or after a counted number of steps, and resets its counter before returning.

name: call_if_flagged_then_set
description: Calls a routine only when a flag word is non-zero, then writes a fixed value to a global that the listed facts associate with the interrupt request register, and returns the incoming arguments unchanged.

name: setup_audio_channels_zero_one
description: Programs the pointer, length, period and volume registers of audio channels zero and one with fixed values, enables DMA, waits for a raster line and calls a helper, then sets a flag word.

name: update_channel_effect_slides
description: On each tick, if a countdown global is set, walks channel effect records and switches on the effect type. It slides a period downward clamped at a minimum, slides it upward clamped at a maximum, or sets a target value, writing the results to the channel record.

name: decode_shifted_bit_pattern
description: Part of a bit-driven decoder: it shifts a data word one bit at a time and, when the word empties, writes a stored value into an output block and updates a state word in a structure. It returns once the output is written.

name: decode_shifted_bit_pattern_entry
description: Another entry into the same bit-driven decoder. It shifts a data word one bit at a time, writing stored values into an output block and updating a state word in a structure.

name: decode_shifted_bit_pattern_alt
description: Another entry into the same bit-driven decoder. It stores a field from the caller and then shifts a data word one bit at a time, writing stored values into an output block.

name: set_flag_then_decode_bits
description: Sets a flag bit in a global from the caller's value, then runs the same bit-driven decoding loop, writing stored values into an output block.

name: advance_channel_effect_state
description: Advances one channel's effect state: it copies a pending value, slides a level toward a target and clamps it, and when the effect code is 16 it adds a step to a volume field clamped at 64. It then moves to the next channel record and dispatches to a handler for each non-zero code.

name: subtract_step_and_dispatch_effect
description: Subtracts a step from a level and clamps it at a target, then applies the same volume step with a clamp at 64. It calls a handler selected from a table by the effect code.

name: set_interrupt_handler_registers
description: Writes a fixed value, a handler routine address, a stored value and a single bit mask to several globals. The listed facts tie these to the CIA-B interrupt control and the interrupt request registers.

name: set_audio_channel_lengths
description: Writes eight stored table values and one further value to a global register, then writes a single bit mask to it. The listed facts tie these writes to the audio channel location and length registers and to the CIA-B interrupt control and interrupt request registers.

name: shift_extend_bit_into_word
description: Shifts a word held in a structure one bit to the left, inserting the extend flag bit, writes a fixed value to a global, and returns the input word with its low byte set.

name: configure_cia_interrupt_control
description: Writes a fixed value to one control global, zero to another, and 136 to a third. The listed facts associate these with the CIA-A control and interrupt registers and the interrupt request register.

name: apply_relocations_and_copy
description: Walks a relocation list, adding the load address to each listed longword in the image, then copies the image's longwords to the destination buffer.

name: copy_counted_byte_rows
description: Copies byte rows from one buffer to another in nested loops, reading row lengths from the source and repeating a row for a count, until the destination reaches its end.

name: parse_bit_table
description: Scans a table of word pairs until the masked input matches the stored value, then computes a bit mask from byte fields and register contents, combining a bit selected by a shift count, and returns it.

name: mask_and_conditional_call
description: Ands two words together and, when one byte argument is less than another, calls a routine and returns its word instead of the masked result.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without changing memory or registers.

name: read_four_bytes_into_longword
description: Reads four consecutive bytes from the address register and packs them into the low longword of the result register, with the first byte in the highest position.

name: build_code_table_from_lengths
description: Builds a table of codes from a list of code lengths. It assigns codes in order by length, reverses the bits of each code, and stores each code with its length.

name: interleave_bitplane_columns
description: Looks up entries in a word table and, for each one, merges alternating-bit masks of source longwords into a destination buffer, 128 longwords at a time. It repeats for a count taken from the caller.

name: drive_head_step_sequence
description: Drives a control byte through a sequence of bit set and clear steps, reading a status bit from a port and looping while it is set. It toggles a direction bit and pulses the step line for a number of iterations taken from a helper's value.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Busy-waits while a bit in a status global is set, then returns.

name: start_disk_read_transfer
description: Sets the disk sync word and the adjust control register, points the disk DMA pointer at a fixed buffer, and starts a read with a fixed length. It then polls the interrupt request status until the disk block-finished bit is set, and clears the transfer enable.

name: toggle_bit_pulse_when_even
description: Toggles bit two of a control byte, and when the data value is even it clears bits one and zero around a helper call and sets bit zero again, calling a second helper.

name: set_control_bits_by_index
description: Sets bit three and then bit seven of a control byte with helper calls between, clears bit three, and sets the bit numbered by the low three bits of the data register.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately without changing memory or registers.

name: wait_for_beam_position_step
description: Spins on a beam position register read as a timing wait, returning when the test on the value holds. Because the register changes between reads, the loop does not run forever.

name: spin_delay_loop
description: Counts down from a fixed value in a tight loop to produce a delay, then returns.

name: select_cpu_variant_and_setup
description: Calls two operating-system library routines through a library table and compares the result with two fixed values to choose a variant, storing the choice in a global. One variant writes a short instruction sequence and a jump into low memory; the other sets up the custom registers, clears the colour registers and installs low-memory vectors.

name: patch_memory_instructions_to_calls
description: Scans a memory region for specific move instruction encodings that write to a fixed global and replaces them with calls to a routine. It also rewrites a few other instruction sequences and then writes call and jump instructions at fixed addresses.

name: install_jump_hook
description: Writes an absolute jump to a routine into a fixed low-memory location and writes a call instruction to a second fixed address, then returns the byte argument unchanged.

name: patch_move_instructions_range
description: Scans a memory range for move instructions that write to a fixed global, replacing each with a call to a routine. It then calls a routine through a stored pointer and returns.

name: copy_block_and_install_jump
description: Copies a block of longword pairs into low memory from a fixed address, writes an absolute jump instruction to a fixed low-memory location, then calls a routine and returns its byte result.

name: patch_move_instructions_range
description: Scans a memory range for move instructions that write to a fixed global, replacing each with a call to a routine. It then writes a call instruction and calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: return_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its data register argument unchanged.

name: start_blitter_and_wait
description: Writes a word taken from the stack to the blitter size register, then spins while the blitter-busy bit is set before returning.

name: start_blitter_size_from_pointer
description: Reads a word through a pointer passed on the stack, writes it to the blitter size register, and spins while the blitter-busy bit is set.

name: write_blitter_size_and_wait
description: Writes the word in a data register to the blitter size register, then spins while the blitter-busy bit is set.

name: enable_dma_and_strobe_copper
description: Clears one global and writes a fixed DMA enable value to another. The listed facts link these to the DMA control register and the copper jump strobe.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever without doing any work, so it acts as a halt point.

name: wait_forever_on_beam_position
description: Loops forever in an empty loop. The listed facts show it touches the beam position register, so it acts as a halt point.

name: wait_forever_on_beam_position
description: Loops forever in an empty loop. The listed facts show it touches the beam position register, so it acts as a halt point.

name: call_object_method_passthrough
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer at a fixed offset in an object held in a global, then returns the data register values it was given.

name: call_object_method_passthrough
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer at a fixed offset in an object held in a global, then returns the stack argument it was given.

name: call_object_method_passthrough
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer at a fixed offset in an object held in a global, then returns the data register values it was given.

name: verify_keyboard_code_or_halt
description: Compares the byte argument with a stored global value. If they match it writes a fixed mask to a global and returns; otherwise it loops forever. The listed facts associate the byte with the keyboard serial register.

name: verify_keyboard_code_or_halt
description: Compares the byte argument with a stored global value. If they match it writes a fixed mask to a global and returns; otherwise it loops forever. The listed facts associate the byte with the keyboard serial register.

name: disable_all_interrupts
description: Writes the all-bits-disable value to a global that the listed facts associate with the interrupt enable register, then returns.

name: install_vectors_and_copy_image
description: Issues a system trap, clears the colour registers, and copies a small routine and a block of longwords into low memory. It then sets a vector address and calls a routine that takes over.

name: clear_colors_and_copy_image
description: Disables interrupts, clears the colour registers, and copies a small routine and a block of longwords into low memory. It then calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: copy_image_and_call_entry
description: Copies a block of longwords from the source into low memory at a fixed address, then calls a routine through a pointer taken from the argument.

name: shuffle_marked_block_in_place
description: If the first longword matches a fixed signature, it copies 120 bytes into globals, moves the block's bytes in a chunked loop with helper calls, and copies the 120 saved bytes back at the end. Otherwise it returns with no change.
